meta.title: Da Nang’s Famous 5-Star Beach Resort | Full Tour of Pullman Danang
meta.description:
Join me for a full tour of the Pullman Danang Beach Resort, one of the most well-known 5-star beachfront hotels in Da Nang, Vietnam. In this video, I walk through the resort’s rooms, pool, breakfast area, and beachfront — with honest feedback based on a friend’s recent stay.
If you're researching where to stay in Da Nang, this hotel inspection gives you a close look at what to expect at Pullman Danang in 2025.

🏨 About Pullman Danang Beach Resort:
Located directly on Bac My A Beach, Pullman Danang offers 5-star beachfront accommodation with tropical gardens, ocean views, and international-standard service. It’s a popular choice for honeymoons, family trips, and business travelers in Central Vietnam.

✅ Who This Video Helps:
Travelers researching 5-star beachfront hotels in Da Nang
Tourists deciding between Pullman, Hyatt, InterContinental, or Furama
People visiting My Khe Beach, Hoi An, or Marble Mountains
Viewers looking for a realistic hotel tour, not just polished promos
